title: Admin reviews the Membership Log
description: Open Membership Log to see apply, activate, update, deny, and delete history for members.

steps.title: Membership Log
steps.body: Membership Log is under Admin, next to Payment Log and Attendance Log.

steps.title: Lifecycle history
steps.body: Filter by action and date. Rows survive member deletion so you can still see who applied or was denied.
steps.resultNote: Membership Log lists APPLY, ACTIVATE, and UPDATE rows from the tutorial seed.
